svg.aria-label: A scatter of every team-season from 2015 to 2025, talent composite across and share of production returning up the page. A shaded corner marks top-30 percent talent with top-quartile returning production, where clubs win 69 percent of their games. Eight 2026 clubs sit inside it. Six are ranked in the top fifteen and are listed at the right. Florida, ranked 33rd, and South Carolina, ranked 35th, are marked in red with leader lines.
svg.text: TALENT ACROSS, EXPERIENCE UP THE PAGE
Grey: every team-season 2015–2025. Shaded: top-30% talent with top-quartile
returning production — the corner where clubs win 69% of their games.
EIGHT CLUBS SIT IN THAT CORNER. SIX ARE RANKED IN THE TOP FIFTEEN.
Florida is 33rd. South Carolina is 35th. Both went 4–8 last year.
